messages:
ari: hey team, day 1 here! quick orientation q: where should i post delivery updates, badge requests, and a pic of my desk for seating? also how do i get the onboarding checklists/bot to DM me?
jules: welcome ari :tada: TL;DR -> hardware & delivery photos: #new-hires (put everything in one thread so future newbies can find it), badge/access requests: #people-ops (or ping @marta), desk pics/office seating: #facilities, infra/setup (ssh, VPN): #eng-ops or #eng-infra.
ari: thanks! is there a central place to turn on the bot reminders?
onboard-bot: hi ari  enable onboarding reminders two ways: 1) slash: `/onboard enroll` (starts DM checklist), 2) web: Intranet > Tools > "Onboarding" -> toggle "Enable reminders". To change cadence: `/onboard prefs --freq weekly|daily`. Use `/onboard unsubscribe` to stop. (automated message)
jules: pro tip: run `/onboard enroll --dm` if you prefer DMs, or `--channel=#new-hires` to keep checklist visible to teammates.
ari: cool. any rules about @mentions, gifs, or large attachments in new-hires?
marta: etiquette: keep #new-hires low-noise. Use threads for back-and-forth troubleshooting. Reactions for ack (:thumbsup:) are preferred over extra messages. Avoid @channel/@here unless it's an urgent org-level note. GIFs and celebratory posts? use #random.
ops-robot: Security note: never post photos with ID badges, passport pages, or lease docs in-channel. Use the secure form for PII: https://intranet.redwood/forms/pii-safe (or DM people-ops). We auto-delete images with detected SSNs but please don't rely on that.
ari: good to know. where do I post if the laptop is stuck during imaging?
jules: put a short thread in #eng-infra with this minimal template + attach a photo if there's an error screen:
```
- serial: XXXX-YYYY
- model: MacBookPro15 / DellXYZ
- symptom: e.g., stuck at Apple logo, kernel panic
- error output: paste console logs if possible
- steps tried: reflash, different thumbdrive, safe mode
- timezone/availability for swap: PDT/EST etc.
```
Tag @eng-oncall if it's blocking your first-week tasks.
ari: perfect. what about badge forms or same-day office access?
marta: badge flow: use https://intranet.redwood/badge-request fill manager and office location. Standard turnaround is 24-48h. For same-day, mark "URGENT - same day" and DM me so I can expedite approvals.
ari: and equipment returns / warranty where?
jules: returns & warranty -> #ops-equipment (or open a ticket in the IT portal). If you shipped personal peripherals, put tracking in #new-hires so ops knows to expect them.
ari: last q: do we post onboarding expenses somewhere?
marta: expenses (real reimbursements) -> expenses@redwood or use Concur link pinned in #finance. In-channel receipts are OK as thumbnails but avoid uploading full credit card numbers.
ari: awesome, thanks everyone. enrolled the bot and submitted the badge form. super helpful :smile:
jules: welcome aboard ari! ping us in this thread if anything blocks you. :confetti_ball:
